address: Plaça de l'Esglèsia 1, Romanyà de la Selva, 17245, Spain
bio: A charming restaurant housed in a beautiful 17C farmhouse in a small idyllic mountain village dominated by stone buildings. It comes as no surprise that the restaurant owners (originally from Belgium) love art and spent many years working as interior decorators in private houses and other properties in Barcelona. The menu here features international cuisine alongside a few traditional Catalan dishes, which are always supplemented with a few interesting market-inspired daily specials. The restaurant’s relaxing terrace is a must!...
